shapeSummary: Simplified cylindrical planetary gear motor with its axis along Z. It has an 8 mm output shaft, a 37 mm diameter gearbox section and a 36 mm diameter motor body. The total length is 80 mm to match the placeholder bounds, and the bottom sits at Y=0 with X and Z centered.
warnings: The drawings give no body dimensions. The 37 mm gearbox diameter, 36 mm motor diameter and the section lengths (16, 28 and 36 mm) are assumed.
The 80 mm overall length is a placeholder taken from the bounds. The catalog 'length: 80' may actually refer to the shaft.
The shaft is modeled as a plain 8 mm cylinder. The REX profile, flats and hex are omitted.
Mounting holes, the encoder cap, the wires and connectors, the gearbox end-face details and the pilot boss are omitted because none are dimensioned.
Check all dimensions against the manufacturer drawing before use.
cadquery:
r_g = 18.5
cy = 18.5
# Z runs along the motor axis from -40 (output end) to +40
shaft = cq.Workplane('XY', origin=(0, cy, -40)).circle(4).extrude(16)
gearbox = cq.Workplane('XY', origin=(0, cy, -24)).circle(r_g).extrude(28)
motor = cq.Workplane('XY', origin=(0, cy, 4)).circle(18).extrude(36)
part = shaft.union(gearbox).union(motor)
